records.issue_text: Port-bearing hosts never match: write path stores host:port but record_for_host compares against port-stripped uri.host, defeating the allowlist
records.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost`, the `host` field can be stored with a port (validation regex allows `(:[0-9]{1,5})?` and `before_validation` strips scheme/path but not `:port`). However `record_for_host` parses the incoming URL via `URI(host)` and compares using `uri.host` (which excludes the port) in `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. So an allowlist entry like `example.com:3000` will never match requests from `http://example.com:3000/...` because it queries for `example.com` but the DB row is `example.com:3000`.
